role: active multi-agent runtime and innovation proving ground

repository_state.deployment_surface: No Vercel project clearly linked to this repository was identified during this run.

actions.before: CI could silently skip a missing Baseline Zero receipt and did not bind the Turn-2 receipt package to artifact digests or a separately observed execution-store snapshot.
actions.after: Baseline Zero and Turn-2 evidence are required, Turn-2 summary/report hashes are verified, lineage and metrics are cross-checked, and the point-in-time execution-store security snapshot is bound into CI.

actions.before: The Smithery MCP connector was in the default tool set and could treat transport/protocol failures too permissively without an explicit connection allowlist or remaining-run timeout bound.
actions.after: Smithery is explicit and privileged, requires mutation opt-in and connection allowlisting, fails closed on transport/HTTP/JSON-RPC failures, suppresses remote error-body leakage, and inherits the remaining agent execution budget.

actions.before: Integrity CI used older Node 20 action lines and the repository had no SECURITY.md.
actions.after: Integrity CI uses actions/checkout@v7 and actions/setup-python@v7, and SECURITY.md defines supported-code, private-reporting, secret, connector, receipt, and credential-containment boundaries.

actions.before: The circuit-breaker unit test performed real exponential-backoff sleeps, consuming roughly 45 seconds per matrix job.
actions.after: The test mocks sleep and jitter while still asserting all 15 logical retries and 15 backoff calls; Python 3.10 ran all 51 tests in 0.715 seconds on the PR receipt.

actions.before: The public APEX evidence logger silently defaulted every log call to one case scope and printed raw remote exception text on Supabase failure.
actions.after: Current source requires explicit case scope or APEX_CASE_ID before any remote/local write, normalizes the scope, and suppresses raw remote exception detail while preserving scoped local fallback.
actions.provenance_note: Historical Git objects were not rewritten; the superseded default may remain visible in repository history.

remaining_unknowns_or_gates.reason: The connected GitHub integration returned HTTP 403 for the repository Dependabot alerts endpoint.
The current source no longer contains the case-specific logger default, but repository history was intentionally not rewritten.
The project security advisor reported pg_net installed in the public schema; no migration was applied because dependency impact was not established in this repository run.
requirements.txt uses bounded version ranges and the repository has no lockfile; no lockfile was introduced without a broader packaging decision.
